facts.business: Pradeep Metals Limited is an Indian metal forging company manufacturing forged components for automotive, infrastructure, railways, defense, industrial machinery, and renewable energy sectors.

capacity_or_capex.item: Expansion of machining capacity and phased replacement of older forging equipment

guidance_or_targets.statement: Strategic priorities for FY 2025-26 include expanding into new sectors, increasing the share of value-added machined components, strengthening customer relationships, and driving operational efficiencies
guidance_or_targets.value: Expanding into new sectors, increasing share of value-added machined components, strengthening customer relationships, driving operational efficiencies
